excerpt.zh: 通过新的联系，我们已经获得了通过泛星系贸易市场进行资源买卖的权利。这一定会刺激[Root.GetAdj]经济。
excerpt.en: Through our newly-established contacts, we have gained access to a galactic marketplace for the purchase and sale of resources. This will surely be a great boon to the [Root.GetAdj] economy.

scope.zh: 与市场参与国建立联系后，获得银河市场通道的提示。
scope.en: The notice that contact with a market participant opens access to the Galactic Market.

texts.zh: 通过新的联系，我们已经获得了通过泛星系贸易市场进行资源买卖的权利。这一定会刺激[Root.GetAdj]经济。
texts.en: Through our newly-established contacts, we have gained access to a galactic marketplace for the purchase and sale of resources. This will surely be a great boon to the [Root.GetAdj] economy.

texts.zh: 我们得知恶心的异种们建立了一个交易外星商品的星系市场。尽管我们不愿涉足其中，但市场的大门仍对我们敞开。
texts.en: We have learned of a galactic marketplace for the trade of alien goods, established by the loathsome xenos. While we are naturally reluctant to take part in this exchange, the option is now available to us.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

summary.text:
# 银河市场 / Galactic Market access

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/on_action_events_2.txt · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

两条入口：galcom.60（市场通道事件）与每年的隐藏事件 action.105（events/on_action_events_2.txt:640-668）：市场成立后，非灭绝者的玩家国家若尚无市场权限，且与有权限的国家有通讯，则（0–40 天随机后）收到 action.115。
Yearly hidden action.105 (and galcom.60) give non-homicidal empires in contact with market members action.115.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

action.115 “银河市场”：为国家启用银河市场（enable_galactic_market）并设置 has_market_access；正文按是否排外而不同；唯一选项“确定”。
action.115 enables the market and sets has_market_access; one text for xenophobes.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 无分支。

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 仅尚无市场权限的国家。 Only empires without access.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：action.105 与 action.115；galcom.60 在故事 event-galcom-60（另一审阅者）中。
